'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Francine (2024)|Hurricane Francine]] makes landfall in [[Terrebonne Parish, Louisiana|Terrebonne Parish]], [[Louisiana]], [[United States]], as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 2]] [[hurricane]]. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCUAT1+shtml/112157.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)] 
**The [[National Weather Service]] issues a [[Flash flood warning|flash flood emergency]] for [[New Orleans]] and municipalities west of it, due to the [[Eye (cyclone)|eye wall]] of [[Hurricane Francine (2024)|Hurricane Francine]] stalling over the region. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/live-blog/francine-live-updates-rcna170567 (''NBC News'')] 
*[[2024 Nigeria floods]]
**Due to the [[2024 Alau Dam collapse|Alau Dam collapse]] by heavy [[flood]]s more than 80% of the animals in the [[Sanda Kyarimi Park Zoo]] in [[Maiduguri]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]] have been killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/floods-decimate-nigerian-zoo-wash-crocodiles-into-community-2024-09-10/ (Reuters)]

**The death toll from [[Typhoon Yagi]] in [[Northern Vietnam|northern]] [[Vietnam]] increases to 179 people, with 145 others still missing. The majority of the victims were killed by floods and [[landslide]]s in [[Lào Cai province|Lào Cai]], [[Yên Bái province|Yên Bái]], and [[Cao Bằng province|Cao Bằng]] [[Provinces of Vietnam|provinces]]. * [[Spaceflight]]
** Following the launch of the Russian [[Soyuz MS-26]] spacecraft from the [[Baikonur Cosmodrome]] in Kazakhstan, there were a record 19 people in outer space: the three astronauts on the MS-26 mission, three more on China's [[Tiangong space station]], four people on the SpaceX [[Polaris Dawn]] mission, and nine more on board the [[International Space Station]].
